We use data from the OpenStreetMap project to be able to show you where roads, trails, stores, coffee shops, and hundreds of different types of features can be located.  Approximately a billion points make up the current OpenStreetMap data set, and the collection is continuing to grow at an astounding rate.
    
Mapster doesn't rely on mapping data that quickly becomes outdated.  Approximately once per month, our servers update the map information with the latest changes submitted by hundreds of thousands of users around the world, and keep your iPhone, iPod, or iPad current automatically.  As a Mapster user, you obtain privileged access to incredible maps of our entire planet, at a level of detail never before seen.

If you are planning on exploring an area, all you need to do is tell Mapster to download the details of that location before you leave.
